scripts.install:all: npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix firebase_tests install
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.23.0 emulators:exec --project demo-reemove --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix firebase_tests test"
scripts.seed:emulator: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.23.0 emulators:exec --project demo-reemove --only firestore "npm --prefix functions run seed:emulator"
scripts.verify:backend: npm run lint:functions && npm run build:functions && npm run test:rules
